title: Display switcher offers List, Tech View and Board View and marks the active one
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view (check in Settings > Roles & Permissions > open your role > Work Orders section). The Admin role has both.
  2. Use a desktop browser with the window at least 1024 pixels wide (full screen on an ordinary laptop or monitor). Below that width the page shows only List.
  3. In the top bar, choose the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty"). Create everything below in this location.
  4. Make sure the location has the technicians this case uses (e.g. "Esther Howard"). A person only counts as a technician here when the staff record is Active, Clockable is on, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location. To add one:
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member > enter the first and last name (e.g. Esther Howard), role Technician, Clockable on, Active, enrolled at this location > Save.
  5. Create the work orders this case uses and set their lead technician (e.g. S1-702 led by Esther Howard, S1-352 with no lead):
    • Work Orders > New Work Order > choose a customer (e.g. "Fibridge Commercial") and an asset (e.g. unit TRK-118, 2022 Freightliner M2) > Create. Write down the number the build gives the work order (the numbers in this case are examples).
    • On the work order page set Lead Technician (e.g. Esther Howard) and save. Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders from the top navigation.
  2. Click the All tab on the left of the toolbar.
  3. Look at the display switcher at the right of the toolbar and hover each of its buttons.
  4. Write down the label or tooltip of each button and which one is highlighted.
  5. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Tech View (in the design its tooltip reads "By Lead Tech").
  6. Look at which switcher button is highlighted now.
  7. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Board View (in the design its tooltip reads "Board").
  8. Look at which switcher button is highlighted now.
  9. In the display switcher, click List (in the design its tooltip reads "Table").
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The switcher offers exactly three display options: List, Tech View and Board View.
  • Only the option you are viewing is highlighted: List at the start, Tech View after step 5, Board View after step 7, List again after step 9.
  • Write down the words you see on each button or tooltip. The design's tooltips read "Table", "By Lead Tech" and "Board". A different label alone is not a fail (the wording is an open product question), but a missing option or no highlight is.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10044 (Story 1, Switch between display options); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S1-R1, S1-R9, read 8 Oct 2026. Design: Claude Design export of 8 Oct 2026 (Work Orders.dc.html), toolbar view switch (aria-label "View"); on-screen labels only.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R1: “The Work Orders toolbar offers List, Tech View, and Board View display options.”
  • S1-R9: “The switcher visually indicates the active display option.”
